g.title: None.None.Node.1
g.text: Azure security monitoring with Microsoft Sentinel, Defender for Cloud and automated response

g.title: None.None.Node.26
g.text: Data centre firewalls and proxies send syslog across the site-to-site VPN
to log forwarders in the hub
whose Azure Monitor Agent sends the events to the Sentinel workspace
Azure Firewall logs arrive through a diagnostic setting
VNet flow logs arrive through traffic analytics
Entra ID sign-in and audit logs arrive through their data connector
and Defender for Cloud alerts through theirs
A scheduled analytics rule finds sign-ins from two countries an hour apart and opens an incident
An automation rule runs the containment playbook
The playbook adds the source address to the firewall policy's deny list
and posts the incident to the SOC channel in Teams
SOC analysts investigate the incident in Sentinel
and data export keeps the raw logs in Blob Storage for seven years
